mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_message_inbox (message_id, scope, target, type, payload, status, created_at, expire_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{scope}, #{target}, #{type}, #{payload}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, scope, target, type, payload, status, created_at, read_at, expire_at FROM sys_message_inbox WHERE scope = 'USER' AND target = #{username} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_inbox SET status = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE scope = 'USER' AND target = #{username} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_message_inbox WHERE scope = 'USER' AND target = #{username} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_inbox SET status = 2 WHERE status = 0 AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_message_inbox WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
